--- ## Summary by Sourcery Support configurable LibGen mirrors by adding JSON API search and download handling alongside the existing legacy frontend. New Features: - Add support for JSON API-based LibGen mirrors with paginated search and download-link resolution. - Allow users to select a specific mirror or automatically detect a working mirror. - Display JSON search result year and language metadata while preserving browser access when downloads cannot be resolved. Bug Fixes: - Improve legacy mirror URL handling and reject unrelated or invalid download links. - Bound network requests and retries with timeouts across search and download operations. Enhancements: - Update the plugin to version 1.6.0 and document supported mirrors, mirror selection, and tagged release requirements. Documentation: - Document release tagging and packaging requirements along with mirror configuration and frontend behavior. Tests: - Add coverage for legacy and JSON search, pagination, mirror selection, download resolution, validation, and timeout behavior. - - - This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/ashcoft/libgen-calibre-store-plugin/3) --- ## Summary by cubic Adds configurable LibGen mirror support, including a new JSON API frontend and automatic or manual mirror selection. - Legacy HTML mirrors (`libgen.bz`, `libgen.vg`, `libgen.gl`, `libgen.la`) remain supported; their searches now use the chosen mirror, and download links are validated with bounded retries and timeouts. - JSON API mirrors (`libgen.me`, `libgen.net`, `libgen.xyz`, `libgen.pw`, `randombook.org`) add paginated search, year and language fields, and resolve download landing pages into explicit file URLs. Unresolvable links keep the book page available in a browser. - Users can pick a specific mirror in plugin settings or let the plugin auto-detect the first working one. - Bumps the plugin to version 1.6.0 and documents release tagging requirements and mirror frontend differences. - Adds unit tests covering legacy and JSON search, pagination, mirror selection, download resolution, validation, and timeout behavior. Written for commit 750259ee0ce972f79d9a5865d38a5b08c5a045d6. Summary will update on new commits.

Confidence Score: 3/5

Block private destinations in the download resolver before merging.

Findings

1.   **Mirrors can contact local services** ▶ 2.  **Failed pages hide earlier matches** ▶ 3.  **Test discovery skips Qt setup** ▶
Fix with agent prompt `````markdown ### Issue 1 libgen_plugin.py:183-192 A compromised mirror can return `http://127.0.0.1:8080/?l=chosen` in `links`. `resolve_spa_download` accepts that address and sends a POST to the local service before checking the returned book ID. Block private and loopback destinations before sending requests, including after redirects. **How this was verified:** Mirror-provided URLs supply the host passed to `br.open`, and the only checks before that request require HTTP(S), a host, and an `l` value. ### Issue 2 libgen_plugin.py:122 `search_spa` saves matches until every requested page finishes. If a later page times out or returns an error, the exception escapes and none of the earlier matches reach Calibre. Yield matches as pages arrive, or return the collected matches when a later request fails while still reporting the failure. ### Issue 3 tests/test_libgen_plugin.py:204-205 The tests create `QApplication` only when the file runs directly. Under normal test discovery, that block is skipped, but the settings test still creates a widget. Qt then aborts because no application exists. Create and retain `QApplication` in `setUpModule` or a shared test fixture. --- For each issue above, determine whether it is valid and should be fixed. If so, fix it directly. `````

Summary

Adds alternate LibGen mirrors and bumps the plugin to `1.6.0`. - The store searches selected HTML and JSON LibGen mirrors. - Book details can resolve to explicit download links. - The package and release notes identify version 1.6.0.

Diagram

 ```mermaid %%{init: {'theme': 'neutral'}}%% flowchart TD A[Saved mirror choice] --> B{Auto?} B -->|Yes| C[Probe JSON APIs, then legacy homepages] B -->|No| D[Use selected mirror] C --> E{Frontend} D --> E E -->|Legacy HTML| F[Parse book tables] E -->|JSON API| G[Fetch search pages] G --> H[Book page] H --> I[Fetch landing links] I --> J[POST token to landing host] J --> K[Check book ID and file URL] F --> L[Read download page] ```
Reviews (1) · Last reviewed commit: ["Support alternate LibGen mirrors and tag..."](https://github.com/ashcoft/libgen-calibre-store-plugin/commit/750259ee0ce972f79d9a5865d38a5b08c5a045d6) · [Reviewed by Greptile](https://www.greptile.com/?utm_source=greptile_review&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=review_public&utm_content=ashcoft/libgen-calibre-store-plugin) ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added automatic and manual mirror selection, with support for both legacy HTML and newer JSON-based mirrors. * Improved search and download-link handling across supported mirrors, including paginated JSON results. * **Documentation** * Added guidance on choosing mirrors and notes on search behavior, result details, and possible download limitations. * Documented release packaging requirements, including matching version numbers and attaching the corresponding package.
